messages:
sasha: Quick heads-up — trying to onboard tessera-3b, CI is failing schema lint on config.json. can someone sanity-check weights/tokenizer fields?
elaine: paste the failing bits?
sasha: failing message from validator: "missing required field 'tokenizer.vocab_path' for schema v2". here's the model config we pushed: 
```json
{
  "model_name": "tessera-3b",
  "weights": {
    "s3_uri": "s3://redwood-models/tessera/3b/checkpoint.pt"
  },
  "tokenizer": {
    "type": "hf"
  },
  "serve_options": {
    "max_seq_len": 2048
  }
}
```
sasha: so tokenizer has type but no vocab_path, and CI is strict now. validator-bot: runs schema v2 by default for new onboards.
validator-bot: Config check failed: missing properties -> ["tokenizer.vocab_path"], suggestions: add vocab_path or set allow_legacy_tokenizer=true in metadata.
mike: @sasha we should avoid allow_legacy_tokenizer unless it's a temporary workaround. can you check if tokenizer artifacts exist in the S3 bucket?
sasha: looked quickly, bucket has files: tessera/3b/tokenizer.json and merges.txt — so vocab path should be s3://redwood-models/tessera/3b/tokenizer.json. probably we forgot to set tokenizer.vocab_path in config.
chris: also run into weird special token ordering on this one — tokenizer.json includes custom unk/id ordering that our conversion script might have reversed. worth validating token ids.
robin: pinging @elaine for tokenizer id mapping script (scripts/tokenizer-normalize.py) — Elaine, do you want me to open a quick PR to add the vocab_path?
elaine: I'm on it, will add tokenizer.vocab_path and run schema lint locally. also planning to add a unit check to ensure tokenizer files referenced exist in S3 before merge.
robin: :thumbsup:
infra-ci: CI build queued for branch tessera/onboard-tokenizer-fix — running config-lint and s3-exists checks.
validator-bot: Note: schema v2 introduced required field 'serve_options.memory_profile' for large models (>2B). it's optional but our gate enforces presence for onboards. please include or set memory_profile: "auto".
sasha: oh right, missed memory_profile. adding memory_profile: "auto" now.
mike: once you push the fix, tag me in the PR and I'll give a quick review (mostly to confirm we didn't accidentally point to a wrong tokenizer).
sasha: pushing PR now: https://git.company/repo/pull/4321 — includes tokenizer.vocab_path, memory_profile auto, and a short comment about token id caveat.
chris: while you're there, can you add a short note in the config describing tokenizer version used and conversion checksum. helps future audits.
sasha: good call. adding checksum field under metadata.checksum.
robin: if CI still complains after that, we can relax the validator temporarily with allow_legacy_tokenizer but add a tracking ticket to fix conversion. don't leave it open.
elaine: local lint passes. infra-ci build shows s3-exists passed. waiting on config-lint in CI.
infra-ci: config-lint success. all validators passed. merging scheduled after 10m hold.
mike: great, thanks. can we add a short note in the onboarding checklist about: 1) always set tokenizer.vocab_path, 2) include memory_profile for >2B models, 3) s3 checksum match? saves future ping threads.
sasha: will update checklist doc and add a checklist item in the PR template.
robin: ephemeral note for the team: we plan to roll schema v2 as the default for new onboards starting next week — expect more strict failures like this.
elaine: ack — will prepare a short email and slack post to eng and eng-ml channels.
sasha: thanks all, closing this thread once merge finishes. :white_check_mark:
